_help.items: Item lists take item ids ("minecraft:diamond" or just "diamond") and tags ("#minecraft:meat"). An empty list [] keeps the default.
_help.tameItems: Items that tame a wild adult dragon, e.g. ["diamond", "emerald", "gold_ingot"]. Default: meat (Tide Wyrm also fish).
_help.tameChance: Chance per item that the dragon is tamed (0..1). Default 0.333.
_help.foodItems: Items that heal a tamed dragon and help a hatchling grow. Default: meat (Tide Wyrm also fish).
_help.breedItems: Items for breeding. Default: golden apples.
_help.multipliers: healthMultiplier, attackDamageMultiplier, armorMultiplier, walkSpeedMultiplier, flySpeedMultiplier, abilityDamageMultiplier: 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double.
_help.abilities: false switches an ability off for every dragon (riders and wild dragons, and a hybrid's blood effect).
_help.riderSeeThrough: "off", "first_person" or "always": the dragon you ride is drawn see-through (only for you) so it does not block the view.
_help.wingSound: wingSoundVolume and wingSoundPitch: 1.0 = normal; a lower pitch sounds heavier.
_help.sneakFliesDown: false (default): the sneak key (Left Shift) dismounts, also in the air. true: in the air the sneak key flies down and you only dismount on the ground or in water. In multiplayer set it on the server and in your own game.
_help.restart: Changes take effect after restarting the game / server.
